events.title: Forbidden Love is participating in East Asia Indie Games Celebration 2026 (EAIGC
events.summary: Forbidden Love is participating in East Asia Indie Games Celebration 2026 (EAIGC)!East Asia Indie Games Celebration 2026 will take place from August 5 to August 19, 2026.During the event, you can discover a variety of indie games from across East Asia on the EAIGC event page. A localized demo version of Forbidden Love is also available to play.EAIGC Event Page: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45543967-East-Asia-Indie-Game-Developer/sale/eastasiaindiegamescelebration2026Forbidden Love Demo

events.title: Demo Patch Notes
events.summary: Hello, this is INS, lead of team DOTG. We'd like to inform you that we have quickly addressed several bug reports related to the demo and pushed an update.Fixed an issue where some characters were missing in the Simplified Chinese font.Fixed an issue where the game failed to launch on certain computers.

events.title: The demo for Forbidden Love has been released!
events.summary: Hello, this is INS, team leader of Forbidden Love's development team DOTG.The demo for Forbidden Love has finally been released! The demo features Korean voice acting.We will continue to work hard to bring you an even better experience going forward.We are currently uploading various development updates and content through X (Twitter), so please stay tuned!Thank you.

events.title: Forbidden Love Localized PV Release, Store Page Improvements
events.summary: Hello, this is INS, team leader of Forbidden Love's development team DOTG.We are currently working on localization and store page improvements to provide players from various countries with a more natural and immersive experience. We have published localized PVs for each country, and have further enhanced the Steam store page by incorporating synopses, character introduction images, and game descriptions tailored to each country's language.
